paper_metadata.title: Low temperature rolling (Nb,Fe) co-alloyed TiAl-based alloy and compression property

evidence.quote: In order to obtain a TiAl-based alloy that can be well hot rolled at lower temperature and simultaneously have good mechanical properties, several (Nb,Fe) co-alloyed TiAl-based alloys were designed and studied in this paper.
the addition of Fe preferentially occupies the site of Al. The Fe element can improve the formation of Ti/Al-Fe metal bonding
